hero.headline: A Family Business Built on the Job Site.
hero.subhead: A father and two sons with more than 45 years of carpentry between them, finishing high end homes from the first board to the final trim. The people who quote your job are the people running it on site.

story.heading: Family integrity. Building science. Red Seal craftsmanship.
paragraphs: Renova Design Build is a family run design build company in Surrey, BC, led by Bill Jr. Quesnel with his father Bill Sr. and brother Nicholas. Bill Jr. started Renova in 2023 out of a passion for design and problem solving, after years in wood frame construction with his father's company and running concrete formwork crews of 15 to 20 people.

Today we take on the complete finishing package for high end homes: mitered cedar siding and hemlock soffits outside, millwork, cabinetry, doors, trim and stairs inside, and architectural concrete like formed stairs, retaining walls and planters. Builders hand us whole finishing scopes, and homeowners come to us to design and build kitchens, built ins and wood interiors.

The business has grown almost entirely on referrals. Builders and clients tell us it's the attention to detail, the practical solutions and how easy we are to work with. A partner is on site for the start of every job, the key decisions and the finish, and nothing extra happens without your approval.

leadership.heading: The trade leaders on your job site.
leadership.intro: Renova is led by the Quesnel family. There's no management layer between you and the crew: the people below quote the project and run it on site.

leaders.name: Bill Jr.
leaders.role: Owner, Red Seal Carpenter, Design Lead
leaders.bio: In construction since he was 18, from wood frame homes to running formwork crews of 15 to 20. Bill Jr. leads design on every project: choosing materials that work together and suit the home, then running the build on site to make sure it comes out the way it was drawn.

leaders.name: Bill Sr.
leaders.bio: More than 45 years in construction and carpentry, with a Building Technology certificate from BCIT. Bill Sr. ran his own construction company for years and brings the building science and code knowledge behind every project.

leaders.name: Nicholas
leaders.bio: A Red Seal carpenter who builds the 3D models and drawings in SketchUp and CAD, so clients can see every decision clearly before anything is built.

certifications.heading: Certified, insured and trained in building science.
